scientific_integrity: The all-parameter formulas are proved using equality-atom orbit transitivity and path shortening; independent audit has not occurred. The finite checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted binary relations directly on an infinite pure equality-atom set with finite support. No generalization to ordered atoms, arbitrary orbit-finite carriers or weighted graphs is established. General orbit-iteration arguments cover the reachability cutoff alone; novelty concerns the full exact geodesic normal form. Historic priority can be revisited.
title: Orbit-geodesic normal form for finitely supported binary relations on equality atoms
